title: Bubble tea may not be healthy

paragraphs: Bubble tea, also known as boba, has become a global phenomenon, loved for its colorful look and sweet taste.

Originating in Taiwan in the 1980s, it mixes tea, milk, sugar, and tapioca pearls. Social media helped turn it into a popular trend, but now experts are warning about health risks. Tests in the United States found small amounts of lead in tapioca pearls, made from cassava that absorbs heavy metals from soil. Although the levels are low, repeated exposure may be harmful. Doctors also warn that drinking bubble tea too often can cause digestive problems, kidney stones, and obesity due to its high sugar content, sometimes up to 50 grams per cup. Some pearls can even cause choking, especially in children.
Experts suggest smaller cups, less sugar, and water instead of sweet drinks. Bubble tea is safe in moderation, but unhealthy as a daily habit.

paragraphs: Bubble tea is a sweet drink from Taiwan. It has tea, milk, sugar, and soft balls called tapioca pearls. The drink became famous on social media, and people can buy it all around the world.

But doctors are worried about its health effects. Tests in the United States found small amounts of lead in tapioca pearls. They come from cassava, which can take heavy metals from the soil. Too much bubble tea can cause stomach pain, kidney stones, and obesity. It also has a lot of sugar, more than a cola. Some people can even choke on the pearls.
Health experts say to drink less, take smaller cups, and choose water when thirsty.

paragraphs: Bubble tea is a drink from Taiwan. It has tea, milk, sugar, and small balls. The balls are called tapioca pearls.

People love bubble tea because it is sweet and looks nice. Many young people drink it and post photos online. But doctors say that it is not very healthy. It has too much sugar. Sugar can make you fat or sick. Some people feel pain in the stomach. The small balls can block the throat and make it hard to breathe. This is dangerous for kids.
Bubble tea is good sometimes, but not every day. It is better to drink water when you are thirsty.
